lines.text: Jesus, troubled in spirit, says one of the disciples will betray Him, and they look at one another, perplexed.
Andrew motions to the disciple reclining at Jesus' side, who leans back and asks who will betray Him.
After Judas takes the morsel, Satan enters him, and he goes out into the night.
Jesus gives a new commandment to love one another, so that everyone will know they are His disciples.
Peter promises to lay down his life, but Jesus says Peter will deny Him five times.
